name: Launch: Find Your Mat-ch is here
to: the one site mailing list (notify-me form + Save my spot + homepage signup all feed it)
subject: It's here!!! Find Your Mat-ch™ is live 💕
preview: Pick your tiles, swipe your mats, meet your match.
text:
It’s here!!! 🎉

You asked me to tell you the minute it opened, so here it is: Find Your Mat-ch™ is officially live!

Start with your tiles (or the mat you already love), then swipe through the mats and racks I’d pair with them. Tap ♥ on the ones you love and save your favorite as a match card to send to your mahj group.

[BUTTON: Start swiping → https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/find-your-match]

Want my own picks? My tile set albums (https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/mahjong-tile-matches) are packed with my favorite mat and rack matches, with new albums all the time.

Use code MAHJMATCH to save 💕

Happy mat-ching!
xo, Tiffany

name: Automation: Welcome (new subscriber)
when: right after someone signs up (on from launch)
subject: Welcome to Mahj Matchmaker! 💕
preview: Three fun places to start, plus a few of my favorite reads.
text:
Hi, I’m Tiffany!

I’m so glad you’re here! I match mahjong tiles with the mats and racks that make them shine, so your table comes together just the way you dreamed.

Three fun places to start:

• Find Your Mat-ch™: start with your tiles or your mat and swipe.

• My tile set albums (https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/mahjong-tile-matches): my favorite mat and rack matches for each set.

• The discount codes page (https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/mahjong-discount-codes): every partner brand that takes our code.

[BUTTON: Start swiping → https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/find-your-match]

A few of my favorite reads:

• The Mahjong Buying Guide: How to choose tiles, mats and racks (https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/blog/mahjong-buying-guide)

• The Most Versatile Mahjong Mats: The mats that go with almost everything (https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/blog/most-versatile-mahjong-mats)

• A Holiday Table Without a Christmas Mat: Festive tables with the mat you already own (https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/blog/holiday-mahjong-table)

Have an IRL photo of your table you’d love to share with the Mahj Matchmaker community? Submit it here (https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/share-your-table), or join our Facebook group (https://www.facebook.com/groups/mahjmatchmaker) and share it there. We often pull photos from the group to feature in the tile albums!

Use code MAHJMATCH to save 💕

Happy mat-ching!
xo, Tiffany

name: Automation: Album request thank-you

to: the person who sent the request
subject: Got it! Your album request is in 💕
preview: The most-asked-for sets get matched first.
text:
Thank you for your request!

I keep a running tally of every request, and the most-asked-for sets get matched first. When yours goes live, you’ll be the first to know.

While you wait, try Find Your Mat-ch™ to see the mats and racks I’d pair with your set. Don’t see your set in the catalog yet? Shop by color and pick a similar colorway, and you’ll find plenty of matches to swoon over.

[BUTTON: Start swiping → https://www.mahjmatchmaker.com/find-your-match]

Use code MAHJMATCH to save 💕

Happy mat-ching!
xo, Tiffany
